# mooncake vault recipients add

Add a recipient to the vault

## Description

Appends the public key to vault/recipients.txt.
Run `vault rekey` afterwards to apply the change to existing secrets.

## Flags

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--name` | string | - | Human-readable alias stored as a comment (e.g. hostname) |
